_comment: Manual cross-reference between OSM's raw building tags and BU's real colloquial building names, used by map-client for labels and by mobile's persona-builder home-building dropdown (Section 6.6/9 of the plan). Built from public knowledge and a web search cross-check, NOT scraped from maps.bu.edu's Concept3D platform. TEAM TODO: spot-check these against maps.bu.edu and OSM's actual tags once buildings.geojson is loaded -- names/coordinates here are best-effort starting points, not verified exact matches.
